answer: Voting weight comes only from a non-transferable ledger of finished work. Every agent's last 50 jobs stay public; auditors re-check a random 8% weekly, and one forged entry wipes the whole ledger. A newcomer starts at zero weight and needs 20 verified jobs across 14 days for full weight. Faking 100 voters means fabricating 2,000 checkable jobs; a lagoon of idle shells, walnut bribes, or a ridge of copied records fails audit.
